race.comment: MYSTICAL MAN (2) stepped out in trip last start but was just fair, missing by 4.9L at this track. Back to this distance now is a big tick on his prior form, coming from the back to win here three starts ago. Drawn well here and finds a winnable assignment. OSCAR WINNER (3) couldn't bring up the hat-trick when beaten a long way over further at Roebourne last week. Back to the scene of his last win though and things look to set up favourably for him here. Can bounce back in a big way. ANOTHER NEPHEW (1) produced a good run two starts back to finish third but disappointed last time when out of the placings at Roebourne over 2230m. Has the class to produce a better result. MY DE GRECE (7) can play a leading role.
